messages:
Avery (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. We had a lot of runtime / batching / kernel questions. Dropping a quick live thread for any outstanding Qs and clarifications. Please @Rohit for timeline items or tech details.

Maya (Eng Manager): Can we get a brief on which kernel work is in the next sprint vs. R&D backlog?

Rohit (VP Eng): Short answer: sprint = stability + small perf wins. R&D = bigger kernel refactors (attention fusion, new matmul paths). We aim to land the per-request KV cache fixes and a low-risk batching change in the next 2 sprints.

Jon (Runtime): To add: per-request KV cache fixes are mainly bug fixes (cache invalidation on prompt truncation). Patch is in review: #rw-kv-271. Expect a canary next week.

Linh (ML Infra): On the kernel side, we have an experimental attention fusion PR that improves long-seq throughput ~12% in our microbenchmarks. Still unstable on older GPUs; flagged for R&D.

Camille (Product): What does this mean for hosted customers vs Dedicated? Any rollout differences?

Rohit (VP Eng): Hosted: progressive rollout by model family, automatic fallback to earlier quantized variant if canary fails. Dedicated: customers on committed capacity get opt-in toggle + automated migration plan with SE help.

Maya (Eng Manager): TL;DR: most customers see no disruption. Small latency improvements in steady-state for many workloads once batching/caching changes land.

Avery (CEO): Are there any known regressions we need communications for?

Jon (Runtime): There is a small uptick in tail latency for extremely bursty tiny requests when we enable a new batching heuristic. We have a mitigator: enable the old heuristic for requests under 32 tokens.

Linh (ML Infra): Perf note: the attention fusion shows gains on sequences >1024 tokens. We should gate that behind model/profile detection.

Maya (Eng Manager): Ops plan: canary -> 24h monitor -> staged rollout -> fallback policy. SLI to watch: p50/p95 token latency, error rate, and token throughput.

Rohit (VP Eng): Timeline bullets: KV patch -> canary next week. Batching heuristic (safe variant) -> rollout in 2 sprints. Attention fusion -> prototype this quarter, broader rollout early next quarter if stable.

Camille (Product): Can we get a short runbook for SEs to answer customer questions?

Jon (Runtime): Will write a 1-pager: what changed, expected impact, known edge cases, how to opt-out for Dedicated.

Maya (Eng Manager): Also adding a short FAQ for the console: how to tell if your workload benefits and toggle suggestions.

Avery (CEO): Good — please keep comms crisp. If any customer hits regressions, escalate to incident channel and tag me.

Rohit (VP Eng): Quick technical snippet for folks tinkering locally:

```
# dev build flags (prototype)
./serve --kv-cache=on --batch-window-ms=8 --batch-size-max=256
# if you see tail-latency regressions try:
./serve --kv-cache=on --batch-window-ms=2 --small-request-heuristic=on
```

Jon (Runtime): Note: those flags are dev-only. DO NOT use in prod hosted clusters.

Linh (ML Infra): Q from infra: will quantization profiles be affected? Answer: minor changes; we need one new profile for attention-fused kernels but fallback to existing quantization path supported.

Camille (Product): Any cost implications to call out?

Rohit (VP Eng): Expected to reduce token compute cost slightly for long-seq workloads because of better kernel efficiency; small increase in short-batch scenarios if batching window is longer — we will tune defaults to avoid cost regressions.

Maya (Eng Manager): Follow-ups I'm owning: 1) Runbook + FAQ 2) Canary dashboard with explainer 3) Post-rollout perf dashboard.

Avery (CEO): Thanks Maya. Anything else?

Camille (Product): One customer asked if Dedicated customers could get early opt-in for attention fusion. Is that possible?

Rohit (VP Eng): Yes — SEs can enable opt-in on Dedicated instances after vetting with Runtime team. It's considered beta.

Jon (Runtime): Will post a short checklist for SEs (tests to run, metrics to monitor).

Avery (CEO): Great thread. If there are no more questions, let's close in 24h and move outstanding items to the runtime roadmap epic. :tada:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for rw-kv-271 on cluster us-west-2-canary. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/9876

Maya (Eng Manager): Saw the deploy-bot. Monitoring now. Ping me if you see p95 > 180ms.

Jon (Runtime): Early canary numbers: p50 down ~8%, p95 steady. Will report back in 6h.

Linh (ML Infra): Thanks all — will add perf artifact to the epic.

Camille (Product): Adding SE contact list to the epic too.

Avery (CEO): Closing in 24h unless objections. Appreciated.
